Hey all,

I just received my Villains bundle out here in Australia and the first thing i noticed was that i didn’t actually receive the over sized villain cards,

checking back through my orders they were placed as a separate order back in August 2014 but i assumed from the email correspondence that i had received leading up to the villains release that they would be sent together.

is there any way one of the staff could tell me if they have actually been shipped yet?

Thanks all
